import { Link } from "react-router-dom"; import { Settings, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react"; const LINKS = [ { label: "Master Inventory", desc: "Unified inventory for substrates, vinyl, equipment, labor, lighting, hardware, supplies, metals and concrete", to: "/MasterInventory" }, { label: "Foundation / Masonry Catalog", desc: "Concrete, brick, poles and fill materials", to: "/FoundationCatalog" }, { label: "Foundation Settings", desc: "Labor, timing, masonry and pole-paint calculation defaults", to: "/FoundationSettings" }, { label: "Painting Settings", desc: "Paint mix, coverage, mask, consumables, labor and quantity tiers", to: "/PaintingSettings" }, { label: "CNC Settings", desc: "Machine rate calculator, labor, setup, material multipliers and cut speeds", to: "/CNCSettings" }, { label: "Laser Settings", desc: "Parameter and engraving laser rates, calculators, material multipliers and speeds", to: "/LaserSettings" }, { label: "Metal Settings", desc: "Fabrication, welding and finishing labor defaults", to: "/MetalSettings" }, { label: "Maintenance Settings", desc: "Service action rates, labor, repaint and Maintenance travel", to: "/MaintenanceSettings" }, { label: "Installation Settings", desc: "Install labor, size/height/environment times, conditions, travel and letter pricing", to: "/InstallationSettings" }, { label: "Vinyl Inventory", desc: "Shared vinyl, laminate and transfer-tape catalog", to: "/VinylInventory" }, { label: "Vinyl Settings", desc: "Printers, cutters, laminators, geometry, ink, blade and machine rates", to: "/VinylSettings" }, { label: "Quote Defaults", desc: "Company branding, quote content, validity and default customer-facing display settings for new estimates", to: "/QuoteSettings" }, { label: "Admin Settings", desc: "Users, backups, workflow rules", to: "/AdminSettings" }, { label: "My Info", desc: "Your profile and preferences", to: "/UserSettings" }, ]; export default function EstimatorSettings() { return (

ESTIMATOR SETTINGS

{LINKS.map((l) => (
{l.label}
{l.desc}
))}
); }
